name: connectum-form-logic
requires: Either ECMAScript 2020 modules (the five .js modules) or any engine at ES2019 (form-logic.bundle.js, one script defining ConnectumFormLogic)
Date, in the person's own time zone (Date() is today where the person is, Time() the local time)

Intl.NumberFormat with en-IN and en-US, TextEncoder, TextDecoder, atob and btoa, and the English month name of Date.prototype.toLocaleString: form-logic-host-shim.js fills in whichever of these the engine lacks (load it first); it changes nothing where they exist
Check an engine with form-logic-conformance.json: ConnectumFormLogic.runConformance(...) must report no failures
